name: Systematix Securities Ltd.
about: Systematix Securities Ltd., an investment advisory company, provides equity trading, leasing and equity research, and investment consultancy services. It also offers retail and institutional equity; and corporate finance services. The company was formerly known as Murari Consultancy Private Limited. and changed its name to Systematix Securities Ltd. in December 1994. Systematix Securities Ltd. was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Chittorgarh, India.
